name: Toshiue Kanojo 2
source:
I thought there might be a new encounter

Starting in spring, I'll be advancing to a new school, encountering new people in a new environment
It was Haruto Motomiya, who had been looking forward to it, but,
Even now that December has arrived, it still doesn't reach the girls at all
Rather than being teased for not being able to approach,
Her friends around her go one after another in finding romantic partners.

Amid that anxiety, I was invited by a friend who also didn’t have a boyfriend,
A classroom at dusk, reluctantly heading to the station front to go on a pickup.

There, Haruto was being pushed down by a girl.

“W-won’t you become my lover...?”

I should have responded, “Sure, I’d be happy to!” but,
The other person is a childhood friend who is a year older than me, and on top of that, they had been avoiding me until recently.

Countless “question marks” floating above the head.
What drowned it out was the soft sensation of our lips touching.
